_doc: Frozone skins. Exact-palette ROLE recolour of the supplied sheet (tools/frozone/build_skins.py). Roles: main (48,176,208 suit), shade (48,120,160 suit shade), outline (32,80,104 dark structural outline + skate streaks — always the darkest suit tone), panel (248 white costume panels / hat / gloves / boots), pshade (208,208,216 panel shade), pshade2 (136,152,184 + rare greys, panel deep shade / trim), disc (4 board greys, skating equipment), ice (detached white sparks / bursts / arcs), flash (whole-white hit-flash silhouettes, kept white). Never recoloured: black (visor / outline), skin tones, the ground shadow. ice = [dark, mid, light, core] used by the procedural effects AND the supplied white ice pixels (→ light). pattern: null | stars | circuit | facets | opal (static deterministic hash on suit pixels, baked).

skins.name: Alien X — Cosmic Frost
skins.inspiration: Alien X-inspired: obsidian suit with sparse baked fabric stars, silver trim, violet-white ice. Colour scheme only; facial skin unchanged.
skins.effects: Violet-white ice, stars baked into the suit pixels (static).

skins.name: Upgrade — Cryo Circuit
skins.inspiration: Upgrade-inspired: black / white / green costume with restrained baked circuit lines; mint-green crystal effects with a bright core. Colour scheme only.
skins.effects: Mint ice with a white core; circuit lines static.

skins.name: Diamondhead — Crystal Current
skins.inspiration: Diamondhead-inspired: teal and pale-mint suit, dark navy outlines, faceted-looking ice shading. No new crystal anatomy. Colour scheme only.
skins.effects: Teal faceted ice; facet glints baked into the suit (static).

skins.name: Big Chill — Deep Freeze
skins.inspiration: Big Chill-inspired: midnight-blue suit with cyan and pale-blue accents. No wings or hood added. Colour scheme only.

skins.name: Superman — Arctic Hero
skins.inspiration: Superman-inspired: blue body, the existing white panels in red, gold trim on the panel shading. No cape, no logo; visible hair / facial details unchanged. Colour scheme only.

skins.name: JJK — Infinity Ice
skins.inspiration: Gojo-inspired: navy core, white / silver costume accents and electric-cyan ice. The existing visor is kept; no blindfold. Colour scheme only.

skins.name: JJK — Rose Winter
skins.inspiration: Charcoal suit, wine-red panels and pink trim with pink-violet ice. The head covering is unchanged; no hair drawn. Colour scheme only.

skins.name: Winning Valkyrie — Victory Glide
skins.inspiration: Custom Beyblade-inspired palette: royal blue, silver panels, gold trim, a red-and-gold board; blue-white ice with restrained red / gold ribbon highlights. Colour scheme only.
skins.effects: Blue-white ice; the ribbon's under-line is gold (restrained).

skins.name: Modern — Polar Stealth
skins.inspiration: Streamlined charcoal and icy-teal suit: the contrasting white panels are blended into the suit tone for a continuous fitted look; teal only on the panel trim. Geometry, mask and silhouette unchanged.

skins.name: Opal Aurora
skins.inspiration: Reward-style pearl suit, indigo panels and lilac trim; a subtle cloth shimmer made of discrete static palette bands and iridescent-looking ice. Static (no animation) — also the reduced-effects version.
skins.effects: Iridescent ice through discrete palette regions; static.
